findings.rule: A vehicle unclaimed after 30 days is moved to the auction list automatically.
findings.evidence: Fresh vehicle 01M58GCTSKNAFJAMTR15PP30BW was towed at 1789682337550 (31 days earlier), with zero claims. After its day-30 deadline 1792274337550, the owner filed its first claim at 1792360737596; fileClaim, decideClaim(approve=true), and releaseVehicle all returned state=sent. vehicleDetail confirmed status=released. The daily auction rule can be bypassed by claiming, verifying and releasing an overdue unclaimed vehicle before auctionSweep runs. This demonstrates a direct-call deadline bypass; it does not establish that the scheduled job fails to run.
